verdict.rationale: Private/public Status Pages and auto-publish Workflows let stakeholders get structured updates without joining the incident channel, and AI-generated 'suggested summaries' support drafting those updates. However, no explicit 'subscribe' mechanism for internal stakeholders (e.g., follow/opt-in to specific incidents) is documented, and evidence focuses more on customer-facing status pages than internal exec/stakeholder subscriptions. Missing for 10: explicit internal-stakeholder subscription/opt-in feature, evidence of granular update cadence or digest for non-responders, and independent confirmation of use for internal (not just customer) communications.
